lines.t: One foot in, one foot out
The fence is cutting deep, deep, yeah
One foot in the pasture, one foot in the wind
I'm balanced on a rapture that I never should have pinned
To a doctrine of the men, yeah, I'm clinging to the pen
But the ink is turning black and I'm falling once again
And you said, let go
But I'm tightening the grip on a tradition that is poison
While I'm taking every sip
It's a gulf, it's a gap, it's a trap, it's a shack
And I'm screaming at the wall, but I'm never looking back
I see the door, but I'm starving on the threshold
Holding on to filth like it's better than the pure gold
I'm a bruised wreath swaying in the storm
I'm breaking every habit, I'm breaking every norm
Take the drugs, take the alloy, let the fire start to rise
I'm tired of the lies that I'm seeing with my eyes
The day is getting closer, the door is open wide
But I'm stopping in the middle with no place left to hide
Amen, I said it, I read it, I shred it, I dread it
The debt that I owe, man, I never could credit
I'm clinging to tradition, it's a famine, it's a mission
I'm a bruised reed, dying in a dead superstition
It's a gulp, it's a gap, it's a trap, it's a snap
I'm a lot behind the truth, I'm a map without a track
You said separate, I hesitated
Mediate, I detonated
Replicate the filth and now the spirit's suffocated
I'm empty, I'm nothing, I'm shedding the bluff
In the day of the Lord, yeah, the furnace is huffing
I'm done with the fence, it's intense, no defense
I'm breaking the cycle and paying the expense
Let go
Refine the trust
Take away the alloy
I'm coming out of the churches of men
I'm coming home
